terms.definition: The top number in a fraction, counting the equal parts you have.
terms.function: In 3/4 the numerator 3 counts the three parts you have.
terms.whereItIs: The lit number above the fraction bar.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the 'how much' part of a fraction.

terms.definition: The bottom number in a fraction, naming the equal parts of the whole.
terms.function: In 3/4 the denominator 4 says the parts are fourths.
terms.whereItIs: The number below the fraction bar, fixed at 4 here.
terms.whyItMatters: It gives meaning to the numerator by naming the part size.

terms.definition: Segments of a whole that are all the same size.
terms.function: The numerator counts them — each lit segment is one part.
terms.whereItIs: The equal segments of the fraction bar.
terms.whyItMatters: Equal parts keep the fraction's meaning consistent.

terms.definition: A number made of a numerator over a denominator describing part of a whole.
terms.function: Numerator (parts you have) over denominator (parts in the whole).
terms.whereItIs: The full n/4 display on the plate.
terms.whyItMatters: The fraction is the complete story; the numerator is its top half.
